opening.argument: The segment presents the displayed message as a warning, not an offer to pursue. It shows a text claiming a receipt code was selected for a $1,000 Walmart gift card, then explains that the speaker searched the message instead of clicking its link: “So instead of clicking that link right there, I Googled it first.” The guidance is directed at unfamiliar communications generally: “Do this with any strange text or call you ever get.” The segment further reports that the message was an old scam and conditionally warns that clicking could infect a phone or expose personal information. Nothing shown has the creator promoting or endorsing the link.

citations.quote: So instead of clicking that link right there, I Googled it first.
Do this with any strange text or call you ever get.
In this case it turned out to be an old scam from 2012.
clicking on that link could infect your phone with the virus or take you to a site where they try to get your personal information to steal your identity
